subject: Mythology
title: Ragnarök: The Twilight of the Gods
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ragnarök: The Twilight of the Gods.

hook.text: Ragnarök was not a surprise. Every Norse god knew exactly how and when the world would end.

buildup.text: Three years of winter with no summer. Brothers killing brothers. The sun and moon swallowed by wolves.

discovery.text: Fenrir broke free. Jormungandr rose from the sea. Loki led an army of the dead against Asgard's gates.

twist.text: The gods did not run or hide. They marched out to fight a battle they knew they would lose.

climax.text: Odin fell to Fenrir. Thor died killing the serpent. The world burned and sank into the ocean.

punchline.text: They faced the end with courage, not hope. That was the point.

quiz.question: How did the Norse gods respond to their prophesied doom?
options: They searched for a way to prevent Ragnarök
They fought bravely despite knowing they would lose
They fled to a hidden realm beyond the nine worlds
